title: Quintessential Smoky Chinese Beans Lo MeIN
description: A smoky, molten, hangover-cure Chinese dish featuring baked beans and ferment, this low-fat-friendly lo-mein is a perfect comfort food for any time of day. It combines the flavors of Dongbei cuisine with the convenience of a one-pan meal.
instructions: Cook the lo-mein noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the doubanjiang and stir for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the baked beans, soy sauce, and rice vinegar, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked lo-mein noodles to the skillet or wok, and stir to combine with the bean mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve hot, garnished with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
